## Flamengo plan changes to face Bahia in Brasileirão; see line-up

Flamengo, first and foremost, will have little time to recover from their Copa Libertadores semifinal clash before returning to action in Brazil’s Série A. [...] This Sunday, the 18th, at 6:30 p.m. (Brasília time), Leonardo Jardim’s side face Bahia at Arena Fonte Nova in Salvador in the 31st round, in a crucial match for maintaining their lead at the top.

## OneFootball Videos

The main news for Flamengo is the return of Jorginho, who has served his suspension. The defensive midfielder strengthens the midfield and provides more options for building from the back, controlling the tempo and protecting the defense against Bahia. [...] Jardim is expected to retain the core of the team from recent Brasileirão rounds, making adjustments based on the players’ fitness. Jorginho’s return is the main anticipated change, but the lineup depends on the coaching staff’s assessment.

Jorginho is expected to join Erick Pulgar and Lucas Paquetá in midfield, combining defensive solidity with quality in the buildup. Leonardo Jardim is expected to keep Jorge Carrascal, Pedro and Samuel Lino in attack.
